title: Case-insensitive extension check
prompt: Implement `static bool HasExtension(string fileName, string ext)` — true when `fileName` ends with `ext` ignoring letter case. `HasExtension("photo.JPG", ".jpg")` is true. Null on either side yields false.

tests.name: case
tests.hint: The default comparison would fail the first — say OrdinalIgnoreCase.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Dots inside the name are fine; nulls are false, not crashes.
